options.name: enable_generic_metrics
options.description: Re-use metric names to store different perfdata values for a particular check. Use tags to distinguish perfdata instead of metric name.

options.name: enable_ha
options.description: Enable the high availability functionality. Only valid in a cluster setup.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: host_template
options.description: Specify additional tags to be included with host metrics. This requires a sub-dictionary named tags. Also specify a naming prefix by setting metric. More information can be found in OpenTSDB custom tags and OpenTSDB Metric Prefix. More information can be found in OpenTSDB custom tags.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the OpenTsdbWriter object.

options.name: service_template
options.description: Specify additional tags to be included with service metrics. This requires a sub-dictionary named tags. Also specify a naming prefix by setting metric. More information can be found in OpenTSDB custom tags and OpenTSDB Metric Prefix.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the OpenTsdbWriter object.
